objective: Corregir el canal Gate 4D antes del reintento. La primera ejecución falló antes de SQL porque vars.EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST/PORT/DATABASE están vacías. Reutilizar la configuración no secreta del canal canónico COA ya operativo sin duplicar valores hardcodeados. Corregir también la parametrización IN() del preflight/postcheck. No ejecutar migración en este job; Production prohibida.

actions.old_text:
- name: Validate development connection configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE:-}"
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test -f "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
          test -f "${ROLLBACK_SCRIPT}"
actions.new_text:
- name: Resolve canonical Development SQL endpoint
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test -f "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
          test -f "${ROLLBACK_SCRIPT}"
          test -f '.github/workflows/coa-core-development-migration.yml'
          python - <<'PY'
          import os,re
          from pathlib import Path
          text=Path('.github/workflows/coa-core-development-migration.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          keys=('EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST','EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT','EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE')
          out=[]
          for key in keys:
              m=re.search(r'^\s*'+re.escape(key)+r':\s*[\"\']?([^\"\'\n#]+)[\"\']?\s*$', text, re.M)
              if not m:
                  raise SystemExit('GATE4D_CANONICAL_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND:'+key)
              value=m.group(1).strip()
              if not value:
                  raise SystemExit('GATE4D_CANONICAL_ENDPOINT_EMPTY:'+key)
              out.append(f'{key}={value}')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'],'a',encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
          print('GATE4D_CANONICAL_ENDPOINT=RESOLVED')
          PY
